title: Zonisamide (Zonegran / Zonisade) — maintenance dosing and NPO options

maintenance.doseText: Adults >16 y: 100 mg daily; after 2 weeks 200 mg/day; then 300 and 400 mg/day, each stable ≥2 weeks. 100–600 mg/day effective; no suggestion of more response above 400 mg/day; max 600 mg/day. Once or twice daily
notes: Steady state up to 2 weeks after each change (half-life ~63 h) (Zonegran D&A, Clinical Pharmacology)
evidenceNote: Zonegran label, Dosage and Administration; Zonisade label §2.2

renalNotes: Avoid in renal failure (estimated GFR <50 mL/min) — insufficient dosing and toxicity experience (Zonegran Precautions; Zonisade §8.6)
Stop with acute renal failure or a sustained clinically significant ↑ creatinine/BUN (Zonegran Precautions; Zonisade §8.6)
Mean ~8% ↑ creatinine and BUN, interpreted as a GFR effect (Zonegran Precautions)
Renal disease: caution, slower titration, more frequent monitoring (Zonegran D&A)
hepatic: Not studied; caution, slower titration, more frequent monitoring (Zonegran D&A, Clinical Pharmacology)
ivPo: Oral only — no parenteral formulation (Zonegran How Supplied; Zonisade §3)
enteral: Zonegran capsules 25 and 100 mg: swallow whole (Zonegran D&A)
Zonisade oral suspension 100 mg/5 mL; same mg dosing as capsules; shake well; use an accurate measuring device; discard 30 days after opening (Zonisade §2.2–2.3, §3)
Tube administration not addressed in label — confirm with pharmacy
levels: 10–40 mcg/mL — AES 2024 summary Table 1 (range from AES Treatments Committee clinical experience, not the label)
interactions: Phenytoin, carbamazepine, phenobarbital shorten zonisamide half-life to 27–38 h (vs ~63 h); dose adjustment may be needed when inducers are started, changed or stopped; monitor with rifampin (Zonegran Clinical Pharmacology)
CYP3A4 inhibitors (ketoconazole, cimetidine): no dose change needed (Zonegran Clinical Pharmacology)
Other carbonic anhydrase inhibitors (topiramate, acetazolamide): more severe acidosis, hyperammonemia, kidney stones — monitor (Zonegran Clinical Pharmacology; Zonisade §7.2)
pearls: Sulfonamide: contraindicated with sulfonamide or zonisamide hypersensitivity (Zonegran Contraindications)
Hyperchloremic non-anion-gap metabolic acidosis: baseline and periodic bicarbonate (Zonegran Warnings; Zonisade §2.1)
sources: Zonegran (zonisamide) capsules US prescribing information. Advanz Pharma; revised 9/2026 (user-supplied label)
